answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of the generated answers, we use the F1-score as the primary metric... Additionally, we employ ROUGE-L... to measure the similarity between the generated answers and the reference answers. We also utilize the Exact Match (EM) score... To evaluate the preciseness of selecting evidence paragraphs... we use Accuracy (%).
